screens.title: Four ways to expand an answer
screens.instruction: Watch the video, then open each technique, type an example of your own, and check the model.

items.title: Give a reason
items.support: Because… / The main reason is that…
items.model: I prefer comfortable clothes because I move around a lot during the day.

items.title: Give an example
items.model: For example, I usually wear trainers when I go to university.

items.title: Add a contrast
items.support: However… / Unlike… / In the past…, but now…
items.model: I used to follow trends, but now I care more about comfort.

items.title: Give an opinion
items.model: Personally, I think clothes can show part of your personality.

screens.title: How do phrasal verbs work?
screens.instruction: Watch the video, answer each question, then reveal the explanation to check your idea.

items.question: What is a phrasal verb?
items.answer: A phrasal verb is a verb together with an adverb or preposition that changes its meaning.

items.question: What two types can you identify?
items.answer: Two-part: verb + adverb/preposition. Three-part: verb + adverb + preposition.

items.question: What do you notice about word order?
items.answer: Some two-part phrasal verbs can be separated; three-part phrasal verbs are not separated in the patterns taught here.
